headline: President Biden signed an order updating the Manual for Courts-Martial, the rulebook for military criminal trials.
what_it_does: This order makes the 2024 changes to the Manual for Courts-Martial, which sets the rules for how military criminal cases are investigated, tried, and punished. Presidents update this manual regularly, often to match new laws passed by Congress. No summary was provided, so the specific changes are not described here.

who_it_affects.group: Service members in the US armed forces
who_it_affects.how: Changes may affect the rules used if they are charged with a crime under military law.
They must follow the updated procedures when handling courts-martial.

who_it_affects.group: Victims of crimes involving service members
who_it_affects.how: Updated rules may change how their cases are handled in the military justice system.
